proof_spans.source_role: Original Exercise 6.78 with its complete printed author Comment on physical p. 637: the one-block confinement estimate P_v[max_{j<=r^2}|X_j| <= 2r and |X_{r^2}| <= r] >= e^{-c} for every v in [-r,r]; iteration of the Markov property at multiples of r^2 giving P_v[max_{j<=2n}|X_j| <= 2r] >= e^{-c ceil(n/r^2)}; the last-visit lamp-extinguishing on [-2r,2r] together with the return to the origin giving p_n(o,o) >= exp(-cn/r^2 - c_1 r); and the optimisation r = n^{1/3}, closing with the attribution to Pittet and Saloff-Coste (1999). The uncounted context reprints the lamplighter definition (physical p. 106), its exponential growth (physical pp. 106-107), Theorem 6.29 with the sharpness remark (physical pp. 224-225), Corollary 6.32 (physical pp. 225-226) and the book bibliography entry (physical p. 696). No author step is expanded or repaired, no index is synchronised and no hypothesis is altered.
